author: TheUeki
quote:
Unfortunately, for a GTA game, this isn't a GTA game but a simulator to teach men how to behave differently with women in real life. The female developers destroyed the very essence of the franchise to satisfy their own fantasies by removing all the fun from the game. After 8 hours of gameplay, I've already uninstalled the game. It's not GTA! It only has the name in common with GTA. You can't do ANYTHING fun in the game. Everything is blocked and boring as hell. Both endings are RIDICULOUS. The game is subject to an ideology and the women at Rockstar are happy to have fulfilled the fantasy of killing all fun in men. It's pure and simple female gaze. 

That's the only reason they didn't want to release a physical version. They knew the game would be returned to stores and refunds requested. It's a failure and a betrayal. Again... Again ...

author: TheUeki
quote:
unfortunately after 4 hours of games you have to be honest and finally open your eyes to the elephant in the middle of the room. 

It's not an RPG. It's no longer Bioware and the game has become only openly political, a new license to destroy. 

impossible to make a pretty character, impossible to make dialogue choices worthy of a dark heroic fantasy. Everything is as sanitized as possible and the situations to be defused are worthy of a prepubescent sitcom. Even the colorimetric atmosphere is ultra colorful and all the colors tend towards pink and purple...

for those who don't believe it, the financial and other reports accessible on the internet and official prove that the world of video games is over.

the media are muzzled, the ratings are false. So-called professionals are paid to muzzle players who give their opinions. They can do a positive review bombing but the others must not say anything. I bought the game on these notes and I regret my money... 

At some point, the pros should be honest and the testers should be honest too, but as we must not lose sponsors, all opinions are biased.

signed: A real 37-year-old gamer who tested the game and regrets it.
